nodes.title: Quick Guide
widgets_values:
## How to Use

Set up everything in the *Input Video & Settings* section.

### Target Resolution

Set the target resolution width and height.

### Enable for High Quality

Enabling this sets the steps of the sampler. False is normal quality with 1 step, and True is high quality with 2 steps, but takes longer to generate.

### Creativity

Adjusts the shift value to manipulate the sigma for the scheduler. A lower value adheres more to the source and is less generative, and a higher value is more generative and can create more details. High values can also create noise artifacts.

---

## Long Video

### Frames per Iteration

When the value is lower than your clip length, iterative sampling will activate itself automatically. Here you can control how many frames per iteration are sampled.

### Overlap Frames

Set the number of extra frames generated per iteration for blending each upscaled batch. More frames will take longer to generate, but fewer frames will make the stitched parts more obvious. 16 is a good middle ground.

### Save Image

Set Save Image Sequence to True if you have memory issues, e.g. with long 4K sequences. Activate it to save the upscaled output in between sampling iterations.

nodes.title: Tip:
widgets_values:
Always set the sample count to a multiple of 4 + 1 (e.g. 81, 85, 89, 93 …).
This is required because WAN Video only processes frame batches in that pattern.

This is relevant for Frame Load Cap and Frames per Iteration, as mismatched values can cause glitchy frames.

nodes.title: Custom Prompt
widgets_values:
Documentary-style rooftop construction scene in a real urban environment, photorealistic, natural overcast daylight, soft diffused lighting, crisp realistic textures, high detail, cinematic yet grounded realism. A young worker with short dark hair and shaved sides wears a white face mask, blue work glove, and faded charcoal T-shirt, holding a cordless drill close to the face while concentrating on precise metalwork. The person is seated or crouched on a green corrugated metal roof or container top, looking downward with focused attention. A second worker stands nearby, partially visible, wearing black cargo pants and work shoes, holding a yellow drill. On the metal surface are a marked white panel, timber offcuts, small tools, and work materials. In the background are red sandstone apartment buildings, industrial rooftops, greenery, and distant church spires under a cloudy sky. Medium close-up framing with strong foreground subject emphasis, shallow natural depth, subtle environmental detail, realistic skin, fabric, metal, and tool textures, clean edges, stable anatomy, accurate hands, authentic worksite mood, high clarity, high fidelity, film still quality.

Subtle natural motion only: slight hand adjustment on the drill, a small shift of posture, gentle movement in hair and shirt from light wind, minor body-weight shift from the standing worker, faint movement in nearby plants, stable camera, no dramatic action, no scene change.
